thesis: The page is the stack of flat-pack cartons in a Jersey City tower hallway: every answer is stencilled on a carton side, the stack grows as you tap your pieces, and the page ends by flattening it for haul-away.

signature.name: Stencilled Carton Stack
signature.summary: Corrugated carton tiles with a chamfered flap corner and bridged stencil numerals (PC 03). The hero counter tiles are cartons; a small stack in the right margin (bottom sheet on phones) gains one stencilled carton per tapped piece; wall cross-sections, building checklist codes and review labels wear the same stencil plate; the footer folds the stack flat into a tied cardboard bundle beside the call button.

palette.family: Tower Night + Poured Concrete + Stencil Lemon

layoutMoves: Right margin column (2 of 12) reserved for the carton stack on desktop; content runs in 10 columns
Stencil piece numbers (PC 01-07) set at 18-22vw, outlined, bleeding off the right edge behind each section head
Full-width elevation band of four wall cross-sections drawn in SVG (drywall, plaster, brick, concrete), read left to right
Price list set as a dense packing list: stencil code, item, range, note, tabular figures, hairline rows

motion.intro: Carton tiles rise in a 60ms stagger (520ms total) while the PC 00 plate stamps in; text is readable from frame 0
stories: stack: each tapped piece drops a stencilled carton onto the margin stack (transform only, 320ms, ease-out) and the PC total counts up
draw: on entering the wall band, each cross-section draws its anchor into the wall (stroke-dashoffset, 900ms) as the stencil plate counts to the sample range
motion.hover: Carton tiles lift 4px and their flap corner folds open (clip-path chamfer 14px to 22px), 200ms; links get a yellow underline that grows from the left
